name: Daisy

notes: Gerk remains convinced Daisy is a real small blonde girl who has interacted with him.
According to Gerk, Daisy once stopped time without anyone else noticing.
The Navi present have no knowledge of Daisy despite Gerk mentioning her multiple times.
Dana confirms Daisy's associated flowers appeared despite there being no flowers present.
Plymouth has never personally seen Daisy despite Gerk mentioning her repeatedly.
Plymouth considers Daisy's apparent presence troubling and intends to investigate further.
Flowers are reaffirmed as Daisy's signature.
Dana concludes Daisy was physically present because flowers appeared where none existed previously.

openQuestions: Why does only Gerk appear to recognize her?
Why can seemingly only Gerk perceive her?
How is Daisy able to leave physical evidence such as flowers?
